name: VCCNF Training Loop
definition: A training procedure for a Voxelized Continuous Coordinate Normalizing Flow (VCCNF) that learns to map Gaussian noise to shape latent codes conditioned on voxel data, using MSE loss.
summary: The VCCNF Training Loop optimizes a conditional normalizing flow to map Gaussian noise to shape latent codes using pre-computed embeddings, distinguishing itself by training the density estimator rather than implicit fields directly.
